title: Result Summary
description: ANALYZE-stage exit artifact. Output of result-analyzer. Summarizes run findings vs baselines. Hard ceiling enforced in-schema: status is always 'provisional' and can_cite_thesis is always false — the analyzer never self-freezes; freezing requires the adversarial-reviewer gate plus a human.

baseline_condition_id.description: OPTIONAL. condition_id of the baseline this finding is paired against. When set AND per-seed vectors exist for both this finding's condition and this baseline (in stats_test.enrich_result_summary), a paired significance test is run. Identifies the per-seed baseline vector; baseline_value alone (a scalar) is NOT enough to pair.

p_value.description: OPTIONAL. Two-sided paired-permutation p-value vs the baseline condition, computed only when paired per-seed data exists. Absent/null when no per-seed data — never fabricated from a delta.

ci_low.description: OPTIONAL. Lower bound of the percentile-bootstrap CI for this finding's value (per-seed). Paired with ci_high.

ci_high.description: OPTIONAL. Upper bound of the percentile-bootstrap CI for this finding's value (per-seed).

n_seeds.description: OPTIONAL. Number of paired seeds the significance test and CI were computed over.

significant_after_correction.description: OPTIONAL. Whether this finding is significant at alpha AFTER Holm-Bonferroni correction across all tested findings in this result_summary.

stats_method.description: OPTIONAL. Which permutation method produced p_value: exact (n<=12, all 2^n sign flips) or seeded Monte Carlo.

stats.description: OPTIONAL. Significance-testing summary attached by stats_test.enrich_result_summary. Absent on summaries built without per-seed enrichment.

note.description: Set to 'insufficient per-seed data — no significance computed' when n_findings_tested == 0.
